text:
of the afternoon of octubre bajo the light gloriosa,

in the fountain of mármol that the arrayán orilla,

diluyen the cipreses his esmeralda herrumbrosa

and the arcada of the fondo his tristeza amarilla.


Rosales and naranjos…Mustio the garden reposa

in a verdor that the gold of the autumn apolilla…

¡Sólo, a veces, itself enciende the llama of a rose,

or the gold polvoriento of a naranja brilla!


Mas, dentro of este autumn, there is tanta spring

in gérmenes; and is all tan sweet and apacible,

that antes of abandonarlo, my heart quisiera,

oyendo the melodioso to sigh of the fountain

and soñando with a Lindaraja imposible,

over este viejo banco dormir eternamente…
